info.title: nambli
info.description: Account-scoped calendar API. JSON 256 KiB; files 25 MiB. Cookie mutations require exact Origin plus X-Calendar-Account; Bearer tokens are one account only, read or manage. Invalid explicit Bearer never falls back to cookies. Calendar writes never publish or schedule social content.

post.summary: Record external receipt and independent followups
post.description: No-redirect compatibility alias. Idempotent replay is 200. Requires current revision and atomic comparison of prior publication/followup state. Unknown persists retryable=false/reconciliationRequired=true. Same external ID required for followup updates.
